text: Albert will automatically try to collect your repayment on the due date, and if there aren't enough funds in your linked account, it may attempt again in the following days. Albert doesn't charge late fees or interest on Instant advances, but you won't be able to take another advance until the balance is repaid. Your bank may also charge an overdraft or NSF fee if a withdrawal fails or overdraws your account. If you think you'll miss the date, contact us through the app so we can look at your options.
